meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读写 NanoClaw 的挂载白名单文件 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json,帮你查看、添加或删除 agent 容器可访问的主机目录,并标出每个目录是只读还是可读写。新配置在容器下次启动时自动生效。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist” 等关键词,或要求查看、增删 agent 容器可访问的主机目录时触发。

say.text: 看看现在 agent 能访问哪些主机目录
say.note: 按可读格式列出白名单和读写权限

say.text: 把 /data 加进挂载白名单,只读
把 /data 从挂载白名单里删掉

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads and writes NanoClaw's mount allowlist at ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json, so you can view, add, or remove host directories that agent containers may access, and see whether each is read-only or read-write. New settings apply when containers are next spawned.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or similar keywords, or ask to view, add, or remove host directories that agent containers can access.

say_en.text: Show me which host directories agents can currently access
say_en.note: Lists allowlist entries and their read/write mode

say_en.text: Add /data to the mount allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config
Reads current config, then rewrites it
